workflow.label: Frame the outcome

industries.label: AI consulting and custom software

industries.observed_work: Three classified arcs cover delivery systems, commercial workflows, client integrations, and post-launch operation.

industries.career_context: Led enterprise product launches through two acquisitions and sustained commercial ownership.
industries.observed_work: Current arcs cover CRM, delivery platforms, account reporting, data repair, and a cross-platform subscription product.

industries.label: Commercial fabrication and interiors

strongest_fit.label: Founder or product operator for owned software

limits.summary: Cross-tool comparison uses only the 44-day shared window because source retention differs.
Career context is self-reported. Captured work remains the source for current depth.
The report does not independently verify business outcomes or sole authorship.

evidence_index.summary: Reviewed career history supports founder, industry, operating, and product-formation context.
Three classified arcs support current delivery, operations, product, workflow, and data-integrity claims.
Observed sessions and tool metadata support the agent workflow, concurrency, subagent, and reusable-review claims.
Deterministic aggregation found 196 Claude and 341 Codex sessions in the exact shared 44-day window.
The retained evidence does not independently prove outcomes, sole authorship, or unobserved current industry work.

risk_gaps.label: Direct code authorship
risk_gaps.implication: Pair or verify when the project requires extensive direct coding by one named person.

risk_gaps.label: Specialist engineering risk
risk_gaps.implication: Add focused security, scale, testing, or reliability ownership when those risks dominate.
